entries.test: Public evidence of sustained, reliable delivery of team-scale products by amateurs using LLMs would refute the claim.
entries.note: The opening question reaffirms his earlier prediction. No finite period of failure could establish 'never.'

entries.test: Public demonstrations and production deployment records could establish whether these tools handle demos successfully but fail on complex real-world applications.
entries.note: The question reaffirms a substantive claim about practical suitability.

entries.test: Public maintenance histories and comparative studies could establish the effort and difficulty of fixing and extending code produced through vibe coding.
entries.note: In context, he presents the previously predicted maintenance difficulty as a current reality.

entries.test: Customer surveys, public accounts, and documented reasons for abandoning tools could show whether customers were recognizing these limitations by October 2025.
entries.note: Customer recognition can be evidenced by public reports; declining usage alone would not establish why customers left.

entries.test: Public usage time series through October 2025 could establish whether vibe coding usage declined for several months following a steep initial increase.
entries.note: Marcus endorses the trend himself, although he attributes the chart to Palihapitiya.

entries.test: Controlled public evaluations comparing familiar and out-of-distribution coding tasks could establish whether generalization failures cause the described reliability problems.
entries.note: 'Inability' is stronger than identifying generalization as the problem. The next sentence describes reduced reliability, not complete incapacity.

entries.test: Public evaluations comparing success and reliability on familiar versus unfamiliar projects could test the claimed performance difference.
entries.note: 'Can be fine' describes capability here; the comparative reliability assertion is firm.

entries.test: Public longitudinal studies or documented project histories could establish how commonly initially successful vibe coding experiments subsequently fail or encounter substantial problems.
entries.note: The surrounding discussion gives 'end badly' a practical reading involving reliability and maintenance failures.
